title: City · A wall behind Gerard stays whole
description: Pressed right against a facade that doesn't hide him, the building keeps its wall: only a surface really between him and the camera may open.

steps.caption: Empujando contra la fachada de casa: el muro queda detrás de él y sigue entero
Detrás de un bloque de verdad, el hueco sigue abriéndose
